intro: This app is the companion to the book {{- title}}. Building Fictions publishes it and is responsible for the data it handles.
tracking: The app has no analytics, no advertising and no social media trackers. Recognising the pages of the book happens on your device; the camera image never leaves it.
device: Your progress and settings are kept only on this device, in your browser's storage, together with the content the app has downloaded. Our server receives only the usual requests for the app and its content.
account: We keep your email address, your language, your progress and – only if you said yes – your wish to receive updates. We use them to sign you in and to keep your progress across your devices (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)); the updates only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)), which you can withdraw at any time under Info → Account.
processors: A hosting provider runs our server; bunny.net (BunnyWay d.o.o., Slovenia) delivers the app's content; Amazon Web Services (Ireland) sends the sign-in emails. They process data only on our behalf.
videosTitle: Videos and pages from other sites
videos: Some entries show videos from YouTube or Vimeo or pages from other sites. They load only after you tap to play or show them; from then on that site may set cookies and record what you watch, under its own privacy policy. Info → Settings shows what you have allowed and lets you take it back.
retention: Account data until you delete your account (Info → Account). Server logs only as long as we need them to run the server securely.
rights: You can ask us for access to your data, to correct or delete it, to object to its use or to receive it in a portable form – write to {{- email}}. You can also complain to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
terms1: The app is free to use with the book. Its texts, images, videos and models are protected by copyright – of {{- author}}, Building Fictions and the credited authors. You may use them for yourself; you may not copy, publish or sell them.
terms2: We keep the app running as well as we can, but cannot promise that it always works, on every device and without interruption. We are liable only as far as Dutch law requires.
terms3: Please don't misuse the app or its server – no automated mass access and no attempts to get around its protection.
terms4: We may change these terms; the date below shows the version in force.
law: Dutch law applies; the courts of Amsterdam are competent. If you are a consumer living in another EU country, you keep the protection of the mandatory rules of your country's law.
